title: IBM watsonx.data 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 could allow a local attacker to obtain sensitive credentials due to the…
description: IBM watsonx.data versions 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 contain a vulnerability where a local attacker could obtain sensitive credentials due to the use of a hard-coded cryptographic key. This flaw allows unauthorized access to sensitive information without requiring user interaction or privileges. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.2.
